rows.en: Touya: "Wh-what? I'm supposed to press this...?"
??: "Hey! Who the heck are you?!"
Touya: "Wha--?! Wh-who are YOU?!"
??: "That's what I should be asking!
Can you pilot that thing?!"
Touya: "Oh, you're the one from before...
Thank goodness. You're all right."
??: "Huh...? Y-yeah, I'm fine... That's not the point!
I'm asking if you've ever piloted one before!"
Touya: "Like hell I have."
??: "...Sigh... I figured as much.
You haven't even had an Adjuster... Huh?
Still, I'm surprised you managed to activate it."
Touya: "Beats me. I just thought about it,
and it started moving on its own."
??: "Huh... Are you lucky, or do you have a knack for this...?
Maybe both... Well, if you can make it move,
take that thing down for me! I'm counting on you!"
Touya: "...Hey, they hung up on me, dammit...
I've got no choice. Come on, move..."
Touya: "All right, it's my turn now, right?"
??: "Oh, you're getting fired up! Yeah, that's more like it.
Your Fighting Spirit is going up, too."
Touya: "What the hell's this Fighting Spirit thing?"
??: "Well, put simply, it's something like motivation.
You'll need enough of it to use the special moves you'll learn later,
as well as powerful weapons.
It goes up when an enemy finishes an action, like just now,
when you defeat an enemy, or when you take damage,
among other things."
Touya: "Huh... Well, whatever.
Anyway, now it's my turn... Here goes!"
Touya: "Hey, it looks like that thing's about to move."
??: "Of course. Battles use a turn-based system,
where each side moves its units in turn.
A system you're all familiar with by now, right?"
Touya: "...Who are you talking to?"
??: "Anyway, that's how it works, so we can't do much
until the enemy finishes its actions."
Touya: "Whoa! This looks bad!"
Teacher: "...I'm Ayaka... Still... but...
Koichiro: "...ouya... Hey, Touya...
You can't fall asleep on the first day... Hellooo...?"
Teacher: "..."
Koichiro: "...H-hey, Touya! You're in trouble..."
Koichiro: "The teacher's coming this way... Hey, Touya...
...Well, don't say I didn't warn you..."
?????: "...At last, I've found you."
Touya: "?!"
Ayaka: "Good morning, Touya Kazami."
Touya: "Huh...? Oh, g-good... morning... ma'am..."
Touya: "Ow... That hurt..."
Classmates: "Ahahahahahaha!"
Koichiro: "An attendance book can really rattle your brain, huh..."
Ayaka: "Kazami, would you like your teacher
to show you a good way to wake up?"
Touya: "U-uh..."
Ayaka: "Go stand in the hall."
Touya: "Huh? We're not in elementary school..."
Ayaka: "Then shall we try that again?"
Koichiro: "M-ma'am, hitting him with the edge is dangerous..."
Touya: "I'll stand in the hall."
Ayaka: "Oh, take the buckets, too. ♥"
Touya: "..."
...Friday, April 8.
<FC:5A:3E>    That day, my ordinary life came to an end.
<FC:5A:3E>   I just hadn't realized it yet...
Touya: "..."
Koichiro: "...Wow, you sure know how to start a new school year.
Oh! Were you trying to get that teacher's attention?"
Touya: "...It's not like that."
Koichiro: "Oh, of course. You're right.
You've already got Kasumi, after all.
Same age, next-door neighbor, childhood friend... It's perfect!"
Touya: "How many times do I have to tell you?
She's my childhood friend, but we're not dating
or anything like that."
Koichiro: "Oh, come on...
But that cool attitude of yours is part of your charm, too."
Touya: "Sorry I'm such a downer."
Koichiro: "Oh, come on! I never said that!
I'm sorry about your parents, but isn't it time you..."
Touya: "..."
Koichiro: "Oh, s-sorry..."
Kasumi: "Oh..."
Koichiro: "Speak of the devil. Heading home too, Kasumi?"
Kasumi: "No. I've got club activities now."
Koichiro: "Oh, that's a shame.
I was hoping we could go over our Operation Double Date
at Seaside Park the day after tomorrow."
Kasumi: "A d-double date...?"
Koichiro: 'You don't have to be embarrassed. Chihiro pretty much set this up
for that very reason.'
Kasumi: 'But... I want things like this to happen naturally...'
Koichiro: 'Do you really think Touya will catch on naturally?'
Kasumi: '...'
Koichiro: 'See?'
Touya: "Hey! What are you two whispering about?!"
Koichiro: "Nothing at all."
Touya: "..."
Kasumi: "O-oh, speaking of which, I heard laughter
coming from your classroom this morning, Touya-chan..."
Koichiro: "Oh, right!
Touya really put on a show first thing this morning..."
Touya: "...I'm going on ahead."
Kasumi: "Oh, Touya-chan..."
Koichiro: "Huh? Hey, Touya!
Sorry, I'll tell you about it another time. See you!"
Kasumi: "O-okay..."
Touya: "..."
Koichiro: "Come on, you don't have to sulk like that..."
Touya: "Argh, you're a pain in the ass! Quit clinging to me!"
Koichiro: "That's it. It's better to let your feelings out.
If you bottle them up, you'll only dwell on bad thoughts."
Touya: "...You've changed, haven't you?"
Koichiro: "I have.
You and Kasumi changed me.
So now it's my turn to change you."
Touya: "..."
Koichiro: "With the power of my love..."
Touya: "No thanks."
Koichiro: "Aw, don't be like that...
Oh, right. Today, after this..."
Touya: "?! What was that?!"
Koichiro: "Is something wrong?"
Touya: "A r-robot?!
K-Koichiro, we've gotta get out of..."
Koichiro: "T-Touya, it's a robot! An actual robot...
This is incredible... A giant robot..."
Touya (...Oh, right. He's a robot nut...)
Koichiro: "That's it! Humanity has finally built
a giant robot!"
Touya: "No, that's not it."
Koichiro: "You're c-cool as ever... But it's right there..."
Touya: "Yeah, it's right there, but something's gotta be wrong.
Forget that! We're getting out of here!"
Koichiro: "Awww..."
Touya: "You wanna die?! Get moving!"
Koichiro: "O-okay... Ah!"
??: "Aaaaaaah...!"
Touya: "Guh?!"
??: "Owww!"
Koichiro: "...Ah... A robot, right in front of me...
I-is this divine providence...? Is the universe itself
telling me to climb in and fight?! Heh... Hehehehehe..."
Koichiro: "Up we go..."
??: "Hey! You! What do you think you're doing?!"
Touya: "...Hey."
??: "Oh, there's a perfect rock right here...
Okay... Take this!"
Koichiro: "Urgh!"
Koichiro: "Ugh... M-my dream... crushed..."
Touya: "...Hey! You're still sitting on top of me!
What the hell are you celebrating for?!"
??: "Huh?! Oh, uh... Sorry!"
Touya: "...Dammit... What the hell is your..."
??: "...? What's wro-- Ah! Look out!"
Touya: "Whoa!"
Touya: "Ow..."
Touya: "...What the hell is going on...?
Koichiro, are you all right...? Huh...? K-Koichiro?!
Where'd he go?! Don't tell me... That explosion..."
Touya: "H-hey! Get in that robot and...
...You've gotta be kidding. Why's she gone too?!
Dammit, at this rate..."
Touya: "I won't let that happen again...
I'm not losing anyone else I care about!"
Touya: "If I use that robot... But can I do it?"
Touya: "Ghh... I've got to get in... I have to..."
Touya: "Screw it! Here goes!"
Touya: "H-how do I make this thing move?!
Move! Come on, move!"
Touya: "Huh? Wh-what's this...?"
Touya: "I'm supposed to touch this...? All right."
Touya: "It's standing up...?! How do I know that?
Are these images being sent straight into my head...?"
Touya: "What do I do next...? First, I should get into a stance..."
Touya: "Huh? It moved...
Can I move this thing just by thinking about it?"
Touya: "...So that's how it works! All right, with this..."

review_batches.context: Entire s_001 examined: the first section is a battle tutorial with an unidentified remote caller, followed by Touya's classroom awakening and school scenes. File order is not a claim about VM execution order. The caller remains ??; do not reveal a name from later scenes. Teacher becomes Ayaka only when the source label changes.
review_batches.decisions: One physical source row per English row. Full wording before layout fitting. Speaker prefixes are translated as visible text. FC tokens stay byte-identical. Deliberate ellipses, exclamations and trailing fragments retained; ordinary omitted subjects/verbs restored from context. Heart symbol retained as a player-facing symbol; font coverage must be extended before insertion.

row_decisions.scenario.s_001.o00147.l00: Deliberate unfinished recognition; retain trailing phrase.
row_decisions.scenario.s_001.o001c9.l01: The caller refers to Touya not having received an Adjuster. Do not specify a physical device or injection method beyond source certainty.
row_decisions.scenario.s_001.o00243.l02: Caller asks Touya to defeat the enemy on the caller's behalf; preserve request direction.
row_decisions.scenario.s_001.o006ac.l00: Touya is half asleep and hears disconnected fragments of the teacher's introduction. Do not invent missing clauses.
row_decisions.scenario.s_001.o006ac.l01: Deliberate incomplete overheard speech; the source does not reveal what she will do.
row_decisions.scenario.s_001.o009cf.l00: Upright/vertical book strike rendered edge-on, inferred from the attendance-book exchange; needs visual confirmation.
row_decisions.scenario.s_001.o00a77.l00: Date has no year; do not infer one from the weekday.
row_decisions.scenario.s_001.o00bf3.l01: Sentence continues across rows; relationship denial completed on following row.

review_batches.context: Whole s_001 examined. After school, Koichiro teases Touya about Kasumi, accidentally touches on Touya's bereavement, then whispers with Kasumi about a double date. Touya leaves; Koichiro follows. A giant robot appears and an unidentified girl lands on Touya. The girl's label remains ??.
review_batches.decisions: Keep the change from teasing to grief and back to comedy. Single quotation marks represent source whisper brackets; ordinary speech uses double quotes. Restore omitted subjects from the immediate exchange. Explicitly unfinished source phrases stay unfinished. No gender inferred for Chihiro. One row in, one row out.

row_decisions.scenario.s_001.o00c87.l01: Koichiro trails off while telling Touya it is time to move on after his parents' deaths; do not invent a completed admonition.
row_decisions.scenario.s_001.o00eb9.l00: Kasumi's wish for romance to develop naturally is left unfinished as in source.
row_decisions.scenario.s_001.o0121f.l00: Koichiro's mock-romantic declaration to Touya is retained, without replacing love with friendship.
row_decisions.scenario.s_001.o01339.l01: Touya's escape warning is deliberately interrupted.
row_decisions.scenario.s_001.o0141c.l00: Koichiro trails off while pointing out the visible robot; retain omission only as deliberate interrupted speech.
row_decisions.scenario.s_001.o01734.l01: Koichiro interprets the robot as divine providence and imagines a cosmic command to pilot it. Preserve his melodrama.
row_decisions.scenario.s_001.o018bd.l00: The girl is still physically on top of Touya while celebrating hitting Koichiro; retain direction and referents.

review_batches.context: Whole s_001 examined. The girl warns Touya; an attack and explosion follow. Touya cannot find Koichiro or the girl and resolves to pilot the robot rather than lose another loved one. Initial control sensations and the unexplained incoming image lead into the tutorial found earlier in file order.
review_batches.decisions: Final 25-row slice. Keep abrupt interruptions and thoughts unfinished where source does. Loved ones does not mean only romantic partners. FC:07:3D is a machine control with no player-facing prose and is preserved unchanged. No conclusion is added about what happened to Koichiro.

row_decisions.scenario.s_001.o01afc.l00: Touya addresses the girl and asks her to get into the robot, then discovers she is missing too; preserve the unfinished request.
row_decisions.scenario.s_001.o01b8b.l00: The traumatic earlier loss is deliberately alluded to rather than restated as a completed description.
row_decisions.scenario.s_001.o01ca1.l00: Broken self-encouragement retains source fragments; explicit I restored where the source identifies the actor.
row_decisions.scenario.s_001.o01f46.l00: Touya interrupts himself while deciding how to regain a stance; retain trailing action.
